authorizes: nothing — proposals only; approved decisions live in main/data/publication/url_decisions.json

actions.true_duplicate_valid_canonical: rel_canonical_to_target (head-only; keeps the URL reachable; no noindex)
actions.duplicate_without_valid_canonical: status_quo until the destination is rebuilt or a valid destination exists
actions.needs_reconstruction: status_quo, then rebuild in place from a Knowledge Object (priority = governed evidence)
actions.independent_reference_potential: rebuild in place; promote only via Contract C (preview exists for MoS2)
actions.institutional_navigation: re-render (Gate 12-I) and certify via Contract C R11; duplicates canonicalize to the holder
actions.internal_pipeline_status: targeted noindex candidate (internal build state; no search intent)
actions.generated_unverified_identity: identity review first; then rebuild (entity exists) or retire with its variants (it does not)
actions.unmatched_non_route: register as a route (if it is the better URL for a concept) or retire after link review

stage2_appropriate_by_class.true_duplicate_valid_canonical: no: use rel=canonical (consolidates signals; noindex discards them)
stage2_appropriate_by_class.duplicate_without_valid_canonical: no: wait for a valid destination
stage2_appropriate_by_class.needs_reconstruction: no: canonical concept surface; rebuild instead
stage2_appropriate_by_class.institutional_navigation: no for holders; canonical for duplicates
stage2_appropriate_by_class.generated_unverified_identity: only after identity review shows the entity does not exist
stage2_appropriate_by_class.unmatched_non_route: no: decide register vs retire first

record_fields: path, route_id (joins routes.json and legacy_disposition_registry.jsonl), seo_class (recommended action = actions[seo_class] unless recommended_action is set), canonical_destination, raw_similarity_to_destination, failed_canonical_checks, shorter_existing_url_for_concept, risk, stage2_would_noindex
